subject: Pricing & model list for hosted API
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@medicore.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.chen@medicore.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & model list for hosted API

Hi Laura,

Hope you’re well — I’m Sarah, Head of ML at MediCore Analytics. We’re evaluating hosted inference options for a clinical summarization feature and wanted a simple starting point: can you share Redwood’s standard per-1M token pricing (separating input vs output if you price them differently) and the hosted model list you offer today with the tiering (e.g., standard, high-capacity, embeddings)?

A couple additional details that would help us:
- Typical latency target: <= 300ms p95 for short prompts (~200 tokens)
- Expected monthly volume initially: ~1–2M tokens, with a possible ramp to 30–40M in 6–9 months if ops go well

If you have a one-page rate card or PDF, please attach. Also curious if you offer standard discounts for committed monthly volume (we’re interested in a 6–12 month commit if the unit economics make sense).

Thanks — we’re trying to source quick numbers to include in our internal vendor scorecard.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of ML, MediCore Analytics

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@medicore.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@medicore.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & model list for hosted API

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear context, and great to meet you virtually. Attaching a compact rate card and a quick model matrix that maps our hosted catalog to the common tiers. High level below — happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through.

Quick pricing (hosted API, list price, per 1M tokens):
- Standard tier (general-purpose models, e.g., rwd-base-1): $3.00 per 1M tokens input, $3.50 per 1M tokens output
- High-capacity (larger models for long-context / higher-quality): $6.50 per 1M tokens input, $7.50 per 1M tokens output
- Instruction-optimized chat models: $4.25 per 1M tokens input, $4.75 per 1M tokens output
- Embeddings (per 1M tokens equivalent): $1.20 per 1M tokens

Notes:
- These are hosted list prices (no commit). For committed monthly usage (6–12 months) we typically offer volume discounts starting at 10% for 5M+ tokens/mo and scalable to 25% for larger, contract-backed commitments.
- Pricing above separates input/output when you need accounting split; for invoicing we can provide a blended per-token rate if preferred.
- Model matrix attached: shows which models are considered standard vs high-capacity, recommended latency profiles, and supported sequence lengths.

Attachments: Redwood-Hosted-Rate-Card-Jun2026.pdf

If you can share a simple forecast (monthly tokens by type) we can run a committed quote for you that shows breakpoints. I’ve looped in Monica (account exec) who can own the commercial thread.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Monica / Laura,

Thanks for the heads-up. Price bands look inline with our current hosted tiers. A couple items to confirm before we generate a formal committed quote:
- Ask MediCore for a 6-month rolling forecast (monthly tokens split by model tier) — we’ll use this to run blended pricing scenarios and show committed vs pay-as-you-go economics.
- For a 12-month commit at 25M+/mo we can go to 25% off list; for 5–10M/mo 12% is OK as standard. Anything outside those ranges needs Finance approval.
- If they require separate input/output accounting on invoices we can do that but prefer a blended per-token price for simplicity in contracting.

I’ll prepare a template committed quote with placeholders for forecast and SLA options. Laura / Monica — can you take the next external touch and ask Sarah for the forecast file and any procurement timelines?

—Aditya
Head of Sales Ops

Hi Laura / Monica,

Thanks for the quick reply and rate card. I attached a short forecast (MediCore_usage_forecast_Q3-2026.xlsx) with an expected ramp scenario — month 1: 1.2M tokens, month 2: 2.1M, month 3: 6.5M and we’d expect to be in the ~25–30M range by month 9 if rollout to our enterprise pilot is successful.

We’re very interested in getting a formal committed quote that shows the 6- and 12-month options you outlined and a blended per-token option for simpler procurement. Also could you confirm which hosted models meet our latency target (~300ms p95 for ~200 tokens)? The matrix you attached mentions rwd-base-1 as standard and rwd-long-2 as high-capacity — is rwd-base-1 likely to meet our latency SLO on Redwood Hosted in us-west?

One more ask: please include a stub for contract start date and a rough timeline for onboarding (tech review + SOC2 checklist), we need that for our procurement committee.

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Tom (our Eng lead) who will be the technical counterpart on latency questions.

Best,
Sarah
